mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: The wheel’s stopped. I went back to the mill and there wasn’t enough water coming through to turn it.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Have you been along the channel?

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: As far as the bank. I couldn’t see what was holding it up. Mira needs to look at it.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: Could you help her, too? There may be something to clear, and I’m not much use for that today.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Caelan, you were just going out—

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: I can practise later. I’ll go with her.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: *with relief* Thank you. There’s still grain waiting, and people need their flour before they can start baking.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Try her workbench outside the workshop, before the upper bridge. She should be there.

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: I’ll tell her what you’ve seen.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: I’ll head back to the mill. You can find me there.

mill_arrival.speaker: serene
mill_arrival.text: Keep to the bank until you know what’s wrong, Caelan.
